mark: Each name gets a plate cut at its end corner in the name's colour, the letters in the machine's mono. The round mark is a notched square, never a circle; the corner glyph sits on the uncut corner. The current mark has a plain yellow outline.
stackbar: The share bar is a notched track with scan lines. A part you point at lights its circuit grid in one tick; the threshold is a cyan reticle tick, and the title is a prefixed mono label. On arrival the bar is torn in sideways and jitters home in six held ticks.
bullets: A warned or over-threshold row locks its figure as a target: four 2 px corner brackets in the tone's ink round a mono read-out, no filled plate. Rows are torn in one tick after each other; a hovered link row lights its circuit.
tick: A changed figure stutters home: a yellow and a cyan copy sit 6, 4, 2, 1 px off and come home in four ticks, the figure itself never moves. Held poses only, no easing.
uptime: The strip is decoded start to end in ten held steps. A cell you point at lights its circuit and takes a yellow outline; the title is a prefixed mono label, the percentage a cyan read-out.
uptime-states: Loading is the busy card with the reticle lock-on; an error summary is the red-ink outline with the page's sentence. Every state keeps the strip's height.
uptime-phone: At 390 px the strip and its summary keep one line each; the tear, circuit and outline behave as at full width.
inbox: A row has a 3 px bar for its state; a failed or warned row is locked as a target with four corner brackets in the tone's ink. Pointing at a row lights its circuit in one tick. Rows are torn in one tick apart, meta lines are mono capitals.
backlog: The same rows with the payload in a notched mono slot. The dead message is locked red, claimed and pending keep the badge and Delete as cyberpunk's own.
files: The file type is a mono tag, a missing file is a row locked red, and View and open-in-tab are cyberpunk's notched buttons.
appointments: The next appointment has a yellow bar and a cyan lead; past rows go quiet by ink. Times are mono read-outs.
checks: A warning check is locked as a target in the amber ink with its fix written under the title after a yellow prompt; failed is the same in red. No hazard band, no filled plate.
sort: The sort a page carries out is drawn in cyberpunk's own table header, unchanged from the approved table: a column that cannot be sorted now is quiet and gives no pointer.
kv: Keys are cyan prefixed mono capitals; a changed row carries a yellow mark; a row that could not be read is locked red and the grid keeps its place.
formrows: Labels are cyan mono capitals with their small print in plain text, controls keep cyberpunk's notched frames, and a failed row is locked as a target.
tiles: Choices are notched slots. Pointing at one lights its circuit and yellow rim; a press lights it full; a checked tile is the holo card, with the yellow rim glowing inward.
card-states: Loading is the busy card with the reticle's lock-on, empty and failed fill the same footprint (the failure is the red locked alert with a normal Retry), ready is torn in sideways in six ticks.
header: The page header keeps its title and badge; the freshness line beside it is a small cyan mono read-out in capitals.
art: Cyberpunk's set is the HUD: a holo card cut at its dossier corner with the reticle's four corner brackets in yellow. Nothing found is the reticle hunting wide; error is the card torn in two with red bands; offline is four bars of signal struck through; done is the reticle closed on a tick; locked is a notched padlock. Each is torn in sideways and jitters home in six ticks.
pipeline: Lanes are holo plates cut at their dossier corner with a diagonal scan line; the head is a prefixed mono label with the count in the condensed display. A card lights its circuit when pointed at and the chosen card is held by four cyan corner brackets.
pipeline-states: Loading is the reticle's lock-on on the busy card over lanes that keep their place; empty and failed fill the board with a normal Retry; lanes tear in one tick apart.
journey: The path is tripwire dashes until a step is reached, then a solid yellow line with a faint glow; marks are notched squares, the current step is held by a cyan outline, titles are mono capitals and dates cyan.
journey-states: Loading is the lock-on over the path, no dates yet keeps the dashes, and the phone width turns the path to a column.
contact: Moments sit on the run timeline's lanes; pointing at one lights it with a yellow glow, zones are dashed-edged bands, the +1 count is a square mono chip.
contact-states: Loading is the busy card with the lock-on, empty and failed keep the height with a normal Retry.
secret: The value is a notched slot in the mono; shown, it gets the yellow rim and the text is decoded start to end in eight held steps. The countdown is a line of tripwire dashes, a failure locks the field as a red target.
secret-phone: The same field stacked for 390 px, the dashes keep the full width.
manage: The wide dialog is torn in where it stands. Section headings are prefixed cyan mono labels, sections are divided by tripwire dashes, and the danger section is locked as a red target with !! before its heading.
confirm: The dependents list is a notched slot with a scan line; a blocked removal shows no field.
type-dialog: The name to type is a yellow mono chip, what is lost is a notched slot headed in red capitals; when the typed name matches, the input takes a cyan rim.
type-own: In the page's own dialog every state keeps one height; the match line is a mono read-out that never moves the buttons.
type-phone: At 390 px the dialog keeps its order and the match line stays one line.
disc: A notched face with scan lines, cyan marks, a yellow sector and a cyan core at the hub. The sector is a held disc that changes in whole steps.
disc-states: Paused dims the sector; ended locks the face as a red target with a red status word. Every state keeps the face's size.
disc-phone: At 390 px the face is capped to the window; caption and buttons centre under it.
countdown: The digits are the condensed display, the colon a yellow tick, the name and status prefixed mono capitals. Digits sit in fixed cells.
countdown-states: Paused dims the digits; ended locks the plate as a red target and the status turns red.
range: Presets are cyberpunk's segmented control; the custom panel opens under its button on the holo popover plate; bound labels are cyan mono capitals.
range-states: A custom window, a limit, disabled and phone width; an invalid bound gives a red !! message and nothing else turns red.
wheel: The rim is yellow, the pointer a cyan tick, and the wheel turns in held ticks (a pose about every 100 ms), never an ease. The winning name stutters home as a figure does; labels are mono.
cook: One step at a time: the step is torn in sideways when you move to it, the ingredients are a notched slot with a cyan header, the counter and amounts mono. Loading, failed and empty keep the height.
timers: Each timer is a holo card with the time in the condensed display and the name and state as mono capitals. An ended timer is locked as a red target with a red state word, the plate staying void.
quantity: Minus and plus are cyberpunk's notched buttons around a notched slot; the figure and the unit are mono.
checklist: A row lights its circuit when pointed at, a ticked item is dimmed and struck, the head is a cyan prefixed label; rows tear in a tick apart.
tri: A chip that must be in lights its circuit with a yellow rim; one that must not be in is locked as a red target with a struck word; the summary is a cyan mono read-out.
code: A holo plate with scan lines, the title a cyan prefixed mono label over a dashed rule, the gutter mono.
command: The terminal is a prefixed cyan label over a dashed rule; the prompt is yellow; the plate is notched at its dossier corner; the code is decoded in eight held steps.
command-long: Long commands wrap or scroll inside the notched plate; continued lines keep their gap and never run under Copy.
command-phone: At 390 px the head stays on one line and Copy keeps its width.
compare: The divider is a cyan line with a glow, the grip is a notched square, and the labels are prefixed mono capitals.
compare-live: Loading lays the busy card with the lock-on over the images; a failed image shows its words and a normal Retry in a notched slot.
